go build -o ok64.wasm ./ok64
exists ok64.wasm

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmstrexport

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

//go:wasmexport bad
func bad() string { return "nope" }

func main() {}
-- ok64/main.go --
package main

//go:wasmexport ok
func ok() int64 { return 1 }

func main() {}
